'''Bjorn Neervoort''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Helmond tournament]] on 11 June 2000 with Tatooine/JP disarm/duel/operate/yab/etc deck, according to Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d937">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-helmond-netherlands-june-11thd937/ helmond-netherlands-june-11th], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-helmond-netherlands-june-11thd937/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
